item.text:
Final handoff — the report is up to date at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

Two confirmed defects, both with executed evidence:

**F2 (production code, consensus-adjacent admin surface).** [Commands.java:766](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/admin/Commands.java:766) builds the admin `snapshot` command's `RateLimiter` with `TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS` while the interval comes from `zookeeper.admin.rateLimiterIntervalInMS` (default `300000`, documented "Defaults to 5 mins") and the sibling `RestoreCommand` uses `TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS`. `RateLimiter` converts via `unit.toMillis`, so the endpoint limits at 300 ms, not 5 minutes — an authenticated admin client can stream the whole data tree several times per second. Reproduced over the production objects in [work/repro/](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java) (`SnapshotCommand intervalInMs = 300` vs `RestoreCommand = 300000`; second request accepted after 400 ms). `TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS` occurs exactly once in the whole main tree; no other unit mismatch exists; the admin suite passes 42/42 anyway because the harness zeroes that interval (`ZKTestCase.java:102`).

**F3 (test code).** Running the suite created `work/zookeeper-server/foo/{version-2}` and `bar/{version-2}`: `ZkDatabaseCorruptionTest.java:190` uses `new FileTxnSnapLog(new File("foo"), new File("bar"))` with relative paths, so the fixture lands in the module directory. The repo already has `ZKTestCase.createEmptyTestDir()` for this, and the 3.9.5 release notes list ZOOKEEPER-4780 "Avoid creating temporary files in source directory" — so the captured tree's tests still mutate the source tree (visible via `diff -rq ../source .`), which can also leak stale `version-2` state into re-runs.

Also recorded: F1 (`QuorumPeerMainTest#testLeaderOutOfView`) as a falsified race; E1/E2 as environment blockers (sandbox hostname resolution, external DNS); the 239-class/1805-test coverage log; the reviewed consensus paths with their negative results; and §6's leftover leads (end-to-end `/commands/snapshot` check with a non-zero interval, unrunnable SSL/Kerberos/hammer classes, remaining 3.9.x checklist items). The captured implementation and its dependencies were not modified; all diagnostic material lives under `work/repro/` and `work/audit-notes/`.
